No estás estudiando. Estás leyendo. You're not studying. You're reading.

We learn best when it matters to us. Wanting to understand a story, relate to a character, or discover what happens next motivates us to explore vocabulary and expressions we haven’t yet learned. This is the basic concept behind Comigo: using our natural curiosity to learn a language.

Comigo is a library of original Spanish comics — westerns, mysteries, time travel, apocalyptic worlds, aliens, WW1 soldiers, WW2 spies and more. Every bubble has audio and translation, and every word explains itself when you tap it. The exercises can be done while reading or hands-free, with user audio input or without. It’s fun, natural, memorable, and it builds real Spanish.

Presently for beginners and intermediate learners. Advanced will be arriving soon.

How a page works

🔊

Read & listen

Follow the story bubble by bubble with native Spanish audio. Show or hide the English translation whenever you want — or never look at it at all.

👆

Tap to understand

Any word, tapped, explains itself — meaning, grammar, the form used in that exact sentence — and saves to your notebook for later.

🎙️

Say it back

Speak the dialogue and Comigo listens and grades you. Hands-free with AirPods, so practice fits a walk, a commute, a queue.

Finish the episode. Keep the Spanish.

Every episode ends with its own practice suite, built from the story you just read. The off-screen modes are fully hands-free — AirPods in, phone in your pocket.

Just listen

Off screen

Screen off, eyes free. Hear each line and its meaning — no speaking.

Listen in Spanish

Off screen

The whole episode, start to finish, in Spanish only — like an audiobook you can already follow.

Read & speak

On screen

Look at the English, say it in Spanish, reveal the text when you need it.

Listen & speak

Off screen

Hear a line, speak it back and get graded — Spanish→English or English→Spanish.

Drill the key words

The episode's key vocabulary, drilled three ways: writing, speaking, listening.

Not another language app.

Comigo is a comic-reading experience that happens to leave Spanish behind. No streaks, no boring drills. Just stories you actually want to finish — made for adults and older teenagers who dropped every flashcard app they ever tried.

Native-voice audio, per bubble

Every line performed with tone and character — not text-to-speech monotone.

Reveal or hide translations

English is there when you want the safety net and gone when you don't.

Listen & Speak practice

Hear the line, say the line, get graded — Spanish→Spanish or English→Spanish.

A notebook that fills itself

Words you tap and lists you find in the story are saved for self-testing.

Interactive story pages

Buttons, screens and clues hidden in the artwork open into the language.

Beginner and intermediate levels

Series are levelled, so the next episode is always within reach.
